quote_zh: Preparation of / 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic / Acid (the centred title as printed, one fragment per line, lines 116, 117 and 118) ... 121.3 g (88.4% of theory) of 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro4-methylsulfonyl-benzoic acid were obtained. Purity: 96% (HPLC) Melting point: 207-208° C. According to HPLC analysis, the reaction mixture contained 87% of product and 10% of reactant.

100g of 2-chloro-3-methyl4-sulfonylmethylbenzoic acid were suspended in 400 ml of chlorobenzene. A 250 ml glass flask was initially charged with 5 g of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-sulfonylmethylbenzoic acid in 50 ml of methylene chloride and 50 ml of water.
